title: The homology edge on the fixed module resolution
statement: Let $g:T\to S$ be a scheme map, $q\in\mathbf Z$, and $K\in D(\mathcal O_T)$. Let $I_K$ be the fixed K-injective representative with $r_K:QI_K\simeq K$ [def-weil-pbc-truncated-counit-edge]. The direct-image comparison [def-pc-ringed-spaces-derived-direct-image] and homology factorization identify $H^q(Rg_*K)$ with $H^q(g_*I_K)$, and $H^q(K)$ with $H^q(I_K)$. Conjugating the kernel/cokernel edge [def-weil-pbc-left-exact-homology-edge] by these isomorphisms defines $e_K:H^q(Rg_*K)\to g_*H^q(K)$. For every $k:K\to L$, one has $H^q(Rg_*k)e_L=e_Kg_*H^q(k)$.

source.place: cohomology.tex Tags 0BKJ (lemma-sheafification-cohomology), 0D5X (lemma-unbounded-describe-higher-direct-images), 079W (lemma-adjoint); derived.tex Tag 0156 (section-right-derived-functor). The kernel/cokernel and unit calculations are agent-derived.

proof.text: Direct image is a right adjoint to module pullback, so preserves finite limits. Apply the edge to the degree-q short complex of the fixed representative and transport along the two homology isomorphisms.

Lift any derived morphism between the fixed representatives to a complex map using the K-injective Hom bijection and fullness of the homotopy quotient. Naturality of the derived unit proves naturality of the resolution comparison. Naturality of homology factorization and of the short-complex edge then give the asserted equation, cancelling the representative isomorphisms.
